metadata.title: CSAB Institute Priority Metadata — JoSAA 2026

tier_legend.1: Top-tier — very high demand, closing ranks well below 10k General
tier_legend.2: Mid-tier — good demand, closing ranks 10k–50k General for most branches
tier_legend.3: Lower-mid — moderate demand, 50k–1L General closing ranks
tier_legend.4: Bottom-tier — niche/new institutes, limited placement data

placement_rating_legend.A+: Avg package >12 LPA, 90%+ placed, top product companies visit
placement_rating_legend.A: Avg package 8–12 LPA, 80–90% placed, good core + IT mix
placement_rating_legend.B: Avg package 5–8 LPA, 60–80% placed, decent placements
placement_rating_legend.C: Avg package <5 LPA or <60% placed, limited data

notes: Priority is for general B.Tech / CS / IT programs.
Architecture students: treat SPA Delhi/Bhopal/Vijayawada as Tier-1 picks.
Food Tech: prioritize NIFTEM, IIFPT over generic GFTIs.
Textile/Carpet: IICT Bhadohi, IIHT Varanasi are niche leaders.
counselor_priority_rank is GLOBAL across all 90 institutes (1 = most preferred).
